content.rationale: The centered log Dirichlet concentrations describe how evidential mass is distributed across intents independently of total evidence. OOS queries can have an atypical concentration shape for their logit-predicted intent even when vacuity or energy appears in-distribution.

A class-conditional standardized tail score on that residual emphasizes unsupported deviations while allowing different intents to have different residual variability.

content.method:
Fit an ID feature origin \(u\) (e.g. \(u=-\mathrm{pinv}(W)b\) for classifier logits \(z=Wf+b\)) and PCA on \(f-u\); for a test feature, let \(r=(I-VV^\top)(f-u)\), set virtual OOD logit \(v=\alpha\|r\|_2\), with \(\alpha=\sum_{\rm ID}\max(z)/\sum_{\rm ID}\|r\|_2\).  
Use the OOD score `exp(v) / (exp(v) + exp(logits).sum())` (numerically, `softmax(concat([logits, v]))[-1]`), where larger means more OOD.

For features, softmax-normalize each cached feature vector and each class prototype (the mean training feature for that class), compute \(s_{\rm feat}=\min_k 2\arccos\!\left(\sum_j\sqrt{q_j\,\bar q_{k,j}}\right)\), and use a calibrated/weighted sum of \(s_{\rm logit}\) and \(s_{\rm feat}\), with larger values indicating OOD.

content.method: Fit PCA on ID features, retain the low-variance eigenvectors `V_low`, and compute `r = np.linalg.norm((f - mu) @ V_low, axis=1)`; set `alpha = mean(max(id_logits, axis=1)) / mean(r_id)` and virtual logit `v = alpha*r`.  The ViM OOD score is the virtual-class probability `exp(v)/(exp(v) + sum(exp(logits)))` (implement stably as `sigmoid(v - logsumexp(logits, axis=1))`), with larger values indicating OOD.

content.method: L2-normalize each cached feature vector, compute each test vector’s Euclidean distances to all normalized ID-training features, and use its \(k\)-th smallest distance as the OOD score (larger = more OOD; equivalently use its negative as an ID-confidence score). Normalize the per-layer scores using their in-distribution statistics and aggregate them (e.g., mean or maximum across layers); larger aggregate distance indicates OOD.

content.method: TRUSTED pools each example’s Transformer hidden-layer features (e.g., average the per-layer CLS vectors) into \(z\), then uses its empirical Tukey depth relative to pooled training vectors \(z_i\): \(D(z)=\min_{u\in U}\min\{\frac1n\sum_i[\,u^\top z_i\le u^\top z\,],\frac1n\sum_i[\,u^\top z_i\ge u^\top z\,]\}\), approximating the direction set \(U\) with random unit vectors. Use low depth (or score \(-D(z)\)) as OOD; classifier logits are not required for this score.
